title:
Configuration for a {@link GenAiGenerativeProxy}.

To configure this config, copy {@link App.PublicKey} from client app to the service app
(`copy(C3.app().publicKeyContent)`) and configure its access by executing {@link Genai.ChatService#allowAccess} in
the service app:
```javascript
Genai.ChatService.allowAccess('<client-app-id>', '<client-app-public-key>');
```

Then configure client side by calling {@link GenAiGenerativeProxyMicroservice#setServiceAppId} in the client
cluster.

Please note that the service {@link App} should be started with 'genAiCodeAssistant' pkg or with pkg that depends on it.

You can check connectivity by calling `GenAiGenerativeProxy.forName('<proxy-name>').validate()` from the client app.

Note that Microservice does not support multiple backends configured simultaneously. Therefore, {@link GenAiGenerativeProxy}
is a singleton that depends only on `Microservice.Config.forName('GenAiGenerativeProxyMicroservice')`.
name: GenAiGenerativeProxy.Config
